name: Chiclana de Segura (Spain)
description: White field with a green bend sinister from the lower hoist to the upper fly, charged at the upper hoist with a red cross of Saint James.
history: Municipal flag of Chiclana de Segura; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: bend sinister from the lower hoist to the upper fly
cross of Saint James at the upper hoist
